### How Honey May Help

- **Energy and blood sugar:** Honey provides fructose and glucose, which can help raise low blood sugar and give a quick energy lift.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXPE3woS-Lv1k5R2UgnXtxXoof58VYGRqEft0fzOC9_kk3nWFoqy-xAkSxHpkgQti-1xmrxl21nBsZuuXMbQ_3jsEGzKcW4csZp6evRnbMALl2mAG2gQu5WREmqasxk-XooCV581pLuw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqgEBxCJF10E-zT0IdgtqErlhBvQLrcvI3xzK8W2A1_awT91426AZQpRpJILrZPYqQ0Ks0xMNr3EaNAd3b7MwjIB9aDM9WTzmI7F5umNUIzQqWQooxkcbf5RVgw6ThsIz9BNS8IQ0CO2_YoG8nKqNXq8AL5o7TvOLTAkkpKck-vP_Pv953n8A4iG_JopfPPa2yhTf92t83yC30QyFJr2R5Da8W4hqYQH_QoF6eg)
- **Traditional pairing:** Pairing honey with toast or crackers is a common folk approach; carbs add gentle calories, while fluids and electrolytes address dehydration. See the [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF1xpiC_eZzNBimBcvLmtqDIVod3BioNpQbdtdzxx3aVjJvUMslUe_eqdJ-Yu21S9LVUvMoUo2aYQfvjwTGZ9jv3SFnbYmEkrDwG1D5o_I7FLFP1TEU6i-zqe73sYHDow0yDqY31CrvMFQpNxkYeOMal_WyOyK0plaGbNU1s9qi4wN2JEVPOyeSPILrSp7Ilc0xQS1T-6_pnIH8eKlcrt62yc6EJ7d) for notes on toast and honey, and [Big Island Bees](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF120Ex-H0plQ5CZRBwqRfULzJdKB0Ph6E5DHBJjBr7JGW3sYFLRXKQ34H2v9HUJ2ysPYyQ3kIqMIgu3o4Thn1ODsIqJkMO0943ZYbTlXaMwVlzuwHB2zcIWu2ErGPczsclGUzoiW1tl7PAYjCsDdso-4MyIyK843-qCx51lGj-mnvTQ) for a traditional toast-and-honey routine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXKDLMRmfil2Nhe3an19DsU6Xv4Te9rxoWM1oF6DWw4ABnfAHqXm2nWsbAzFzFDhzEGIWIOtAqT8eMkp_Q5X4KLDilEn6z0uHEq9pRkKuOv5xI5OUzs4HyppIwrQJB46Sirx1fVH8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF13K1AQOVsaGZgY4cC0bYblVk1XILcYKaejkFmS-MgKibBjK017AAmSt3k1Mk_hmB0ptJKzefNWlrTuzPg7SwyLDLikko7f7AknfCgr5dCEog6p-sekcQUoFYXiZdMrbWe73_a_RFhWsdQCBTZw_3dthsEbLxKMJmfcWUqvZV)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqgEBxCJF10E-zT0IdgtqErlhBvQLrcvI3xzK8W2A1_awT91426AZQpRpJILrZPYqQ0Ks0xMNr3EaNAd3b7MwjIB9aDM9WTzmI7F5umNUIzQqWQooxkcbf5RVgw6ThsIz9BNS8IQ0CO2_YoG8nKqNXq8AL5o7TvOLTAkkpKck-vP_Pv953n8A4iG_JopfPPa2yhTf92t83yC30QyFJr2R5Da8W4hqYQH_QoF6eg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF1xpiC_eZzNBimBcvLmtqDIVod3BioNpQbdtdzxx3aVjJvUMslUe_eqdJ-Yu21S9LVUvMoUo2aYQfvjwTGZ9jv3SFnbYmEkrDwG1D5o_I7FLFP1TEU6i-zqe73sYHDow0yDqY31CrvMFQpNxkYeOMal_WyOyK0plaGbNU1s9qi4wN2JEVPOyeSPILrSp7Ilc0xQS1T-6_pnIH8eKlcrt62yc6EJ7d)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF120Ex-H0plQ5CZRBwqRfULzJdKB0Ph6E5DHBJjBr7JGW3sYFLRXKQ34H2v9HUJ2ysPYyQ3kIqMIgu3o4Thn1ODsIqJkMO0943ZYbTlXaMwVlzuwHB2zcIWu2ErGPczsclGUzoiW1tl7PAYjCsDdso-4MyIyK843-qCx51lGj-mnvTQ)

### What People Say
Opinions on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF13umcnryOVWHTtHjjBtzqVjAqmvpZhlucDzoeKwE7NlvO4-EEZGBvPIdbe_8FWJKzDb8b4RsCWmKKuJ5odMvwI1AYe0hmI3CXRsn6Iloyv49FlpwPiWj3eC-81qDAH42KFrTHJXHXW3pTIWvzfAlOcV4Eo8eUH-C_FJd-TaXOOOrjLdFEUb6flkvqKnThwU7RrhQtHeGT3ELYoHCjQ) are mixed: many users doubt a spoonful of honey cures a hangover beyond a slight energy or mood bump, while one user reported that honey in water helped more than other remedies they tried.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF13umcnryOVWHTtHjjBtzqVjAqmvpZhlucDzoeKwE7NlvO4-EEZGBvPIdbe_8FWJKzDb8b4RsCWmKKuJ5odMvwI1AYe0hmI3CXRsn6Iloyv49FlpwPiWj3eC-81qDAH42KFrTHJXHXW3pTIWvzfAlOcV4Eo8eUH-C_FJd-TaXOOOrjLdFEUb6flkvqKnThwU7RrhQtHeGT3ELYoHCjQ)

### Safer Hangover Basics

- **Rehydrate:** Sip water, electrolyte drinks, or broths.
- **Eat bland foods:** Try toast, crackers, bananas, or oatmeal if your stomach is settled.
- **Rest and avoid acetaminophen:** Give your body time to recover, and avoid acetaminophen after drinking due to liver stress.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqgEBxCJF10E-zT0IdgtqErlhBvQLrcvI3xzK8W2A1_awT91426AZQpRpJILrZPYqQ0Ks0xMNr3EaNAd3b7MwjIB9aDM9WTzmI7F5umNUIzQqWQooxkcbf5RVgw6ThsIz9BNS8IQ0CO2_YoG8nKqNXq8AL5o7TvOLTAkkpKck-vP_Pv953n8A4iG_JopfPPa2yhTf92t83yC30QyFJr2R5Da8W4hqYQH_QoF6eg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXKDLMRmfil2Nhe3an19DsU6Xv4Te9rxoWM1oF6DWw4ABnfAHqXm2nWsbAzFzFDhzEGIWIOtAqT8eMkp_Q5X4KLDilEn6z0uHEq9pRkKuOv5xI5OUzs4HyppIwrQJB46Sirx1fVH8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXn2FvTcp8KMC2rRCj1EfBtjed6VGCnJz9o9_Sx1biPKxqn2mqOUIPocagDkZNvmSIIIQzgfl7jIM16E2HsxyjGtUTxILX-LKFxr74sonIto_ouN043u1QmBR186SSyn0zuczL6ZjacaFLJr-RXjYByg)
